seoTitle: Connect GoDaddy Domain to Google Business Profile
metaDescription: Verify your GoDaddy domain with Google Business Profile for free to boost local SEO and improve your visibility in local search and maps.
intro: Linking your GoDaddy domain to your Google Business Profile is a free way to strengthen your local SEO, but it does require correctly verifying domain ownership. This guide walks through verifying with TXT records or URL verification and adding your domain-based website to your business profile.

steps.heading: Open your Google Business Profile settings
steps.body: Access the section where you can add or verify a website tied to your business listing.

steps.heading: Verify your domain
steps.body: Use either TXT record verification or URL verification to prove you own the GoDaddy domain you're connecting.

steps.heading: Add your domain-based website
steps.body: Link your verified website to your Google Business Profile so it displays correctly in search and maps.

steps.heading: Check your local search visibility
steps.body: Confirm your business profile is showing your domain properly to help improve your ranking in local search results.

faq.question: Is connecting a GoDaddy domain to Google Business Profile free?
faq.answer: Yes, this process doesn't require any paid tools, just domain verification through TXT records or a URL.

faq.question: How do I verify my domain with Google?
faq.answer: You can use TXT record verification added through your GoDaddy DNS settings or use URL verification instead.

faq.question: Does this actually help local SEO?
faq.answer: Yes, linking a verified domain to your business profile can improve your visibility in local search and Google Maps.

faq.question: Who should do this?
faq.answer: It's especially useful for small businesses, freelancers, and local stores using GoDaddy domains who want to grow through Google Search and Maps.
